config.notes: Otago Polytechnic course pages (www.op.ac.nz/programmes/nzqa/...) print a Domestic panel then an International panel (Duration, Level, Credits, Fees, Delivery, Location, Intakes), then Fees sections. All fields are read from the International panel only. Fee is read only when the international duration is whole years full-time (the panel fee is per year for multi-year programmes, per the International fees table https://www.op.ac.nz/international/fees-and-scholarship/international-fees-table; for sub-year programmes it is a whole-course total and is not read). Intakes are printed month names. IELTS from the course English section (Overall Academic IELTS N). Domestic-only pages carry no International panel and give no reading.
